title: “Screen er Arale”: A Groundbreaking Approach to Women’s Safety in Bangladesh Jointly Initiated by UNDP and UN WOMEN Bangladesh
details:
“Screen er Arale”: Empowering Women’s Safety in Bangladesh

Introduction

Catch Bangladesh, in partnership with UNDP and UN Women, introduced the “Safety for Her” campaign, a transformative initiative under the global 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence. This campaign was designed to empower young women with tools and knowledge to ensure safety in both online and offline spaces while encouraging a culture of responsibility and inclusion.

At the heart of the campaign lies “Screen er Arale”, an innovative interactive drama. This first-of-its-kind storytelling approach in Bangladesh not only addresses online harassment but also raises awareness about women’s safety in everyday interactions, consent, and proactive solutions to combat violence against women. The drama was hosted on a dedicated platform, safetyforher.net, enabling widespread access and engagement.

The Challenge

Women in Bangladesh face multifaceted safety challenges, from cyberbullying and privacy violations online to harassment and gender-based violence in their daily lives. Despite increasing awareness, resources often fall short of equipping women with the skills and confidence to navigate these threats comprehensively.

Recognizing these gaps, the “Safety for Her” campaign was envisioned to provide an immersive platform that educates, engages, and empowers women to address safety challenges in both digital spaces and real-life situations effectively.

The Innovation: “Screen er Arale”

“Screen er Arale” redefines Behavioral Change Communication through its interactive video format, where viewers actively influence the storyline. Participants are presented with dilemmas reflecting real-life scenarios related to online safety, interpersonal interactions, consent, and responsible behavior. Their decisions guide the narrative, offering firsthand insight into how actions affect outcomes in various contexts.

Key Features

Interactive Engagement

Viewers shape the story by making choices for the characters, experiencing the power of their decisions in influencing positive or negative outcomes.

Behavioral Insights

The platform gathers data on audience responses, providing valuable insights for refining future campaigns that holistically address women’s safety.

Support System

In addition to education, the campaign connects participants to resources and authorities, offering information and guidance for those facing online or offline harassment.

Experience “Screen er Arale”

“Screen er Arale” is an interactive drama designed to raise awareness about gender-based violence and promote respect and consent. The impact of “Screen er Arale” has been immediate and profound. By blending entertainment with education, the campaign has successfully reached diverse audiences, including young women, parents, educators, and community leaders. Participants have praised the format for its relatability, depth, and unique experience. Beyond individual transformations, the data collected from the drama is informing broader policy and program strategies, creating ripple effects across various sectors.

Lessons Learned

Discover the key insights gained during the development of “Screen er Arale” through an engaging and clear presentation:

?️

Technical Complexity

Ensuring a seamless experience for viewers required multiple rounds of testing and validation across all user interaction points.

?

Storytelling Approach

Crafting a compelling and emotionally engaging narrative was key to motivating audience participation and decision-making.

✍️

Script Writing

Clear and engaging scripts were essential to maintain viewer focus and ensure narrative flow without disengagement.

?

Shoot Planning

Precise planning for costumes, sets, and actor positioning was critical to support the branching narrative structure.

?

Filming Continuity

Consistent lighting, costumes, and sets across storylines were vital to preserve immersion and coherence.

✂️

Editing Sharpness

Precise editing maintained narrative coherence and viewer engagement across branching storylines.

Future Outlook

The “Safety for Her” campaign is more than an initiative—it’s a movement toward creating safe and empowering environments for women across all aspects of their lives. Looking ahead, Catch Bangladesh plans to expand this model to tackle other critical issues such as health & nutrition, mental health, youth leadership, climate resilience, and more.

Back to Top

Conclusion

Through “Screen er Arale”, Catch Bangladesh has redefined how behavioral change communication can address complex societal challenges. By merging innovative storytelling with actionable solutions, the “Safety for Her” campaign has empowered women, engaged communities, and set a new standard for research, BCC, and advocacy in Bangladesh. The campaign has left a lasting impact, transforming lives and influencing societal norms. It has demonstrated that creating safe and inclusive spaces—both digital and everyday—is possible through collective action, innovative tools, and community engagement.

“Screen er Arale” has redefined advocacy in Bangladesh, empowering women and fostering inclusive communities through innovative storytelling and collective action.
